intent: Create an original adult female textile guild master, age 48, pausing at her workshop doorway after an argument; medium close-up for character hair, makeup and costume design.

scene.summary: The guild master holds one folded dye sample at chest level, listening to someone just outside frame.
scene.setting: A modest timber dye workshop with a soft window at camera left and defocused textile racks behind.

subjects.description: Original 48-year-old woman with broad cheekbones, a slightly asymmetric mouth and visible smile lines; self-contained stern expression.
appearance: Ink-blue dense silk outer jacket over an ivory overlapping collar; muted plum lining visible only at the sleeve fold; narrow bronze-thread seam embroidery at collar and cuffs.
Low coiled bun fixed with one plain wood pin; a few gray strands at the temples; tiny hammered-bronze drop earrings.
Satin-matte skin with natural under-eye texture, restrained warm brown eyeliner following her own eye shape, softly irregular dark brows and muted brick rose lips.
subjects.action: Holds folded cloth and listens offscreen.
